name: Kepora Gebora for ending cutscene
description: Controls Kepora Gebora's behavior and cutscene configuration during the ending sequence.
InternalName: エンディング用ケポラ・ゲボラ

fields.name: Behavior
fields.description: Selects the cutscene behavior. Values 0–3 have code references.

fields.name: Cutscene
fields.description: Selects cutscene data and configuration. Values 0–19 have code references; values 18 and 19 trigger additional actor creation.

fields.name: Alternate Mode
fields.description: Selects an alternate cutscene resource and configuration. When enabled, the actor uses a different cutscene data table and may create additional actors depending on Behavior.
